workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: defines reset-ready v2 spec schema after M1788 blocks direct reset feasibility

stop_condition: stop if v2 role surfaces cannot be mapped to executable scenario fields
stop if profile controls or role semantics are lost
stop if design admits ranking by default
stop if next route is ambiguous
fallback_plan: route to executable spec materialization if design is complete
route to materialization/design repair if fields remain ambiguous
route to branch synthesis if no reset-ready design can be made
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1788 requires executable spec design before reset feasibility

admission_evidence: M1788 finds v2 contract complete but lacking reset-ready scenario fields
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1789 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for executable spec materialization or repair

history_necessity_tests: Design must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1771 and M1787 public materialization artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no executable design exists, route to synthesis or repair without weakening self-ID standards.

hypothesis: A reset-ready executable v2 panel spec schema can be designed from M1787 contracts and reusable M1771 bounded-panel fields without running reset or rollout.
success_criteria: M1789 defines executable scenario fields and balancing rules
M1789 maps reusable M1771 fields and identifies new v2 fields
M1789 preserves six v2 role surfaces and twelve profile controls
M1789 preserves no-reset no-rollout no-training no-ranking and no-paper-claim guardrails
failure_criteria: design ranks profiles or claims paper-level evidence

decision_rule: M1789 passes if it defines a reset-ready v2 panel spec schema without reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
